level 2 warrior. This will almost double your hit-points, so you can stay out that much longer.

facts.subject: Level 3
facts.text: Upon reaching Level 3, you learn the Heal spell.

evidence.quote:
After getting to the 3rd 
level, your strategy should change a little. No that you have learned the Heal spell, you have 
no need for the inn!

facts.subject: Man behind desk
facts.text: The man behind the desk in Tantegel Castle refills your magic points for free.

evidence.quote:
You know that guy behind the desk in Tantegel Castle? He can refill your 
magic points - FOR FREE!!

facts.subject: Leather Armor
facts.text: Leather Armor is sold in Brecconary for 70-G, and the shopkeeper buys your clothes for 10-G.

evidence.quote:
Once you have 70-G, head in to Brecconary and get your Leather Armor. He will buy your
clothes for 10-G.

facts.subject: Copper Sword
facts.text: The Copper Sword costs 180-G.

evidence.quote:
Now, you will want to get the Copper Sword
(180-G) before actually going anywhere interesting.

facts.subject: Level 4
facts.text: Upon reaching Level 4, you learn the Hurt attack spell and your magic points triple.

evidence.quote:
Upon becoming level 4, you will learn the Hurt spell (this is an attack spell) and your
magic points will triple.

facts.subject: Slimes
facts.text: At Level 5, Slimes will begin running away from you.

evidence.quote:
The next thing that will happen will probably be your upgrade to Level 5. Now, you are 
quite powerful, and will notice that Slimes are now running from you.

facts.subject: Ghosts
facts.text: Ghosts are encountered in the forest directly north of the mountains north of Tantegel and the hills east of those.

evidence.quote:
Though you should still 
stay away from the bottom row of hills to the south, you can now enter the forest directly 
north of the mountains north of Tantegel, and the hills east of those (but stay away from the 
desert). Here you will encounter Ghosts, but they won't be too tough.

facts.subject: Garinham
facts.text: From Tantegel, head north until you hit water, then head west to reach Garinham.

evidence.quote: Head north, and once you hit water, go west.

facts.subject: Magicians
facts.text: Magicians frequently cast the Hurt spell on the way to Garinham.

evidence.quote:
You might meet some Magicians on the way, but 
they should be no problem. They might make you heal yourself though, because they love to use 
the Hurt spell.

facts.subject: Dragon's Scale
facts.text: Dragon's Scale can be bought at the Garinham item shop for 20-G and used.

evidence.quote: Go ahead and buy a Dragon's Scale(20-G) at the item shop and use it.

facts.subject: Erdrick's Cave
facts.text: Erdrick's Cave is situated in a patch of desert passed on the way to Garinham.

evidence.quote:
You
remember that little patch of desert with a cave in the middle you passed on the way to 
Garinham? It's time to go there now!

facts.subject: Erdrick's Cave B1
facts.text: In Erdrick's Cave B1, head down to the intersection, go east to the wall, up, continue east to the wall, down, and hug the eastern wall to reach the stairs down.

evidence.quote:
Head down to the intersection, and go east. Go as far 
as you can until you hit a wall, go up, then continue east. Next time you hit a wall, go down 
and hug the wall to the east, until you hit some stairs. Go down the stairs.

facts.subject: Erdrick's Tablet
facts.text: Following the wall directions on the second floor of Erdrick's Cave leads to an opening to the south, then south and east to a chest containing Erdrick's Tablet.

evidence.quote:
On the next floor, go in each direction I say until hitting a wall. Up, west, down, west,
up, west, up, west, up, east, up, west, up, east. Now, going east, there will be an opening in
the wall to the south; go through it. Then, go south, east, and--wait! A chest! Take it, and 
you will find Erdrick's Tablet.

facts.subject: Erdrick's Cave
facts.text: Erdrick's Cave is the only cave in the game with no enemies.

evidence.quote:
I 
would just like to say that this is the only
cave in the game with no enemies.

facts.subject: Small Shield
facts.text: A Small Shield costs 90-G.

evidence.quote:
You 
should get up to Level 7, get a Small Shield(90-G), and a Chain Mail(300-G) before leaving the 
continent.

facts.subject: Chain Mail
facts.text: Chain Mail costs 300-G.

evidence.quote:
You 
should get up to Level 7, get a Small Shield(90-G), and a Chain Mail(300-G) before leaving the 
continent.

facts.subject: North-East Continent
facts.text: Leaving Tantegel and heading north then east brings you to a river with a bridge leading across to the North-East Continent.

evidence.quote:
Leave Tantegel, and head north, then east. Eventually, you will hit a river, 
containing a bridge near the middle. Go across. Welcome to the North-East Continent!

facts.subject: Kol
facts.text: After crossing the first bridge, go east, then south across another bridge, head north past a small mountain range, and head northeast into a forest to reach the village of Kol.

evidence.quote:
After crossing the bridge, you should go east, then south, following the grassland. You 
will come to yet another bridge, and should cross it. You should head north now. After passing
a small mountain range, head north-east into a forest, and you will find the lovely village of 
Kol.

facts.subject: Hand Axe
facts.text: The Hand Axe from Garinham costs 560-G.

evidence.quote:
Well, you may remember 
the Hand Axe(560-G) from Garinham. It is time to buy this weapon now.

facts.subject: Half Plate
facts.text: Half Plate armor costs 1000-G.

evidence.quote:
You should also save up 
for a Half Plate(1000-G).

facts.subject: Skeletons
facts.text: Skeletons are well armored and hit hard, but you can put them to sleep with the Sleep spell to attack them.

evidence.quote:
This is for your own good, as Skeletons are armored well and hit hard. If you do get
in a fight with one, though, you should probably run. If you are feeling dangerous, you should
try putting them to sleep and attacking them.

facts.subject: Kol Inn
facts.text: Staying at the Kol Inn costs 20-G.

evidence.quote:
When your hit points and 
magic points get low, you can either head back to Tantegel (make sure you have enuogh hit 
points to make it alive) or use the Kol Inn(20-G).

facts.subject: Staff of Rain
facts.text: In a cave at the top of a peninsula west and north of Kol, a man will give you the Staff of Rain if you bring him the Silver Harp.

evidence.quote:
If you wish, you can head west from Kol, then north on a little peninsula. At the top of 
the peninsula, you will find a little cave. In the cave is a little guy that says if you bring 
him a Silver Harp, he will give you a Staff of Rain (which you will need at some point).

facts.subject: Level 8
facts.text: At Level 8, regular attacks deal 10 to 15 damage, and Slimes, Red Slimes, Drakees, Ghosts, and Magicians run from you.

evidence.quote:
The next thing that will happen is you will graduate 
to Level 8. Upon doing so, you are quite strong, and are having regular attacks from 10 to 15, 
and will have Slimes, Red Slimes, Drakees, Ghosts, and Magicians running from you.

facts.subject: Rock Mountain Cave
facts.text: From west of Tantegel, cross the bridge leading south to the South-West Continent, head south past the mountains, then east avoiding the swamp to find Rock Mountain Cave.

evidence.quote:
Head west of Tantegel to the bridge leading south. Cross it. Welcome to the
South-West Continent! However, we aren't going to stay long, just long enough to get something.
Head south until you pass some mountains. Then head east, avoiding the swamp. Eventually, you 
will come to a cave. Go in. Welcome to Rock Mountain Cave.

facts.subject: Herb
facts.text: In Rock Mountain Cave B1, light a torch, go up and follow the wall past the first stairway to find an herb.

evidence.quote:
Upon entering, light a 
torch, and go up. Follow this wall until you get to a stairway. Pass it. Continue following 
this wall, and you will find an herb.

facts.subject: Rock Mountain Cave B1
facts.text: Continuing past the herb along the wall leads to another stairway going down.

evidence.quote: Continue, and you will find another stairway. Go down.

facts.subject: Chest
facts.text: On B2 of Rock Mountain Cave, going east to an intersection, heading up, and following the wall to the west leads to two chests, one containing a torch.

evidence.quote:
Go
east until you get to an intersection, and go up. Follow the wall above you to the west, and 
you will find two chests, containing a torch and the Fighter's Ring, the reason we came here.

facts.subject: Chest
facts.text: On B2 of Rock Mountain Cave, following the wall to the west after going up at the intersection leads to a chest containing the Fighter's Ring.

evidence.quote:
Go
east until you get to an intersection, and go up. Follow the wall above you to the west, and 
you will find two chests, containing a torch and the Fighter's Ring, the reason we came here.

facts.subject: Chest
facts.text: Continuing along the wall on B2 of Rock Mountain Cave leads to a chest containing 129-G.

evidence.quote: Continue along the wall, and you will find 129-G, and then 15-G.

facts.subject: Chest
facts.text: Continuing further along the wall on B2 of Rock Mountain Cave reveals a chest with 15-G.

evidence.quote: Continue along the wall, and you will find 129-G, and then 15-G.

facts.subject: Level 9
facts.text: At Level 9, you learn the Radiant spell, which illuminates a radius of 3 instead of 1 and makes torches obsolete.

evidence.quote:
With this new level,
you will gain a new spell, Radiant, that will make Torches moot...Radiant also lights up to a radius of 3 instead of 1.

facts.subject: Swamp Cave
facts.text: Inside Swamp Cave, go down, east, down, east, down, west to reach a stairway leading up to the South Island.

evidence.quote:
In this cave, the Swamp Cave (imaginative, huh?), you needn't use Radiant just yet. Simply
follow the directions I give you, going as far as you can in the instructed direction until you
hear a bumping sound. Go down, east, down, east, down, west. You will come to a stairway, and
should go up. You are now at the South Island, home to Rimuldar, the key-town, and the famous
Goldman.

facts.subject: Rimuldar
facts.text: To reach Rimuldar from the Swamp Cave, cross the swamp to solid ground, go south-east then south past the second mountain range, wrap around them to the south, and cross the desert strip surrounded by water.

evidence.quote: After leaving the cave, cross the swamp to solid ground. Heal yourself. Go south-east, then south....After you pass the second mountain range, wrap around them to the south, and cross the desert strip surrounded by water. This is Rimuldar, the fabled key-town.

facts.subject: Rimuldar Key Shop
facts.text: The key salesman in Rimuldar is found by hugging the moat around the top towards the back of town and entering the building next to a man in a green shirt.

evidence.quote: You will also find the keys to the north: Hug the moat, going around the top, towards the back of the town. Once there, you will see a guy with a green shirt next to a building. Go in, and you will find the key salesman.

facts.subject: Rimuldar Key Shop
facts.text: You can purchase up to six keys from the key salesman in Rimuldar.

evidence.quote: Go in, and you will find the key salesman. Go ahead and buy all the keys you can, which should be six.

facts.subject: Broadsword
facts.text: The weapon shop in Rimuldar sells the Broadsword for 1500-G.

evidence.quote: Then, head on over to the weapon shop and check out the new hardware. Yow will notice the Broadsword(1500-G), and the Magic Armor(7700-G).

facts.subject: Magic Armor
facts.text: The weapon shop in Rimuldar sells the Magic Armor for 7700-G.

evidence.quote: Yow will notice the Broadsword(1500-G), and the Magic Armor(7700-G).

facts.subject: Goldman
facts.text: Defeating a Goldman yields around 200-G.

evidence.quote: Eventually, we will go an fight the Goldman, a, well, man made of gold. You can get around 200-G for killing this guy!

facts.subject: Howard
facts.text: Howard is behind one of the locked doors in Rimuldar and reveals that a magic item is four steps south of the bath in Kol.

evidence.quote: There are only two doors in Rimuldar. Behind one is the famous Howard, and he will tell you that, four steps south of the bath in Kol (you know, the one that cures rheumatism), you will find a magic item.

facts.subject: Rimuldar
facts.text: Behind a locked door in Rimuldar you can find wings, which normally cost 70-G.

evidence.quote: Behind the other door, you will find wings. Don't open the doors (unless you absolutely HAVE to see for your self) because the wings only cost 70-G, and two keys cost 106-G.

facts.subject: Rimuldar Inn
facts.text: The inn in Rimuldar costs 55-G to stay.

evidence.quote: Be sure you are sufficently healed (you may wish to use the Rimuldar Inn(55-G)), and leave the South Island the way you came.

facts.subject: Swamp Cave
facts.text: To navigate back northward through the Swamp Cave, follow east, north, west, then north.

evidence.quote: Once in the Swamp Cave, follow these directions to get back northward: east, north, west, north.

facts.subject: Kol
facts.text: Searching the area four steps south of the bath in Kol yields the Fairie's Flute.

evidence.quote: Stop by Kol, and search the area four steps south of the bath. Pick up the Fairie's Flute (hey, didn't we hear about a Golem who hates music? And that Fairie's can put things to sleep? Hmmm......), and head to Tantegel.

facts.subject: Tantegel Castle
facts.text: Behind a locked door on the north side of Tantegel Castle is 39-G and a man who says brave people do not steal.

evidence.quote: Behind the door that you will pass is a guy saying that brave people don't steal (HAHAHA) and 39-G.

facts.subject: Tantegel Castle Barrier
facts.text: Each diagonal damage barrier space in Tantegel Castle inflicts 20 Hit Points of damage.

evidence.quote: Well, don't enter at all (each space of the diagonal stuff takes out 20 Hit Points), for I will tell you what the guy back there says.

facts.subject: Tantegel Castle Cellar
facts.text: In the cellar reached by going east around the lady south of the key salesman and heading south, an old man gives a chest containing the Stones of Sunlight.

evidence.quote: Go near that lady just south of the key salesman, and go around her to the east....Go south, and you will find a little stairway leading down to... the cellar! Go down, and the guy will say he's been waiting for you. Take his chest and find the Stones of Sunlight.

facts.subject: Goldman
facts.text: The Goldman can be fought in the second set of hills south of Rimuldar.

evidence.quote: Then, you can head to the second set of hills to the south of Rimuldar, and fight... The Goldman!!

facts.subject: Goldman
facts.text: When fighting the Goldman, you must cast the Sleep spell; he hits for around 15 Hit Points and takes about 6 hits to defeat.

evidence.quote: When you fight him, there is one thing you MUST do: USE THE SLEEP SPELL! Otherwise, he will completely kick your butt. He hits for around 15 Hit Points, and you will have to hit him around 6 times to kill him.

facts.subject: Stopspell
facts.text: The Stopspell spell is acquired at Level 10.

evidence.quote: Also, once you get Level 10 (you can now hunt around on the little island south of Rimuldar) and the Stopspell spell, you might want to try it on the Warlocks.

facts.subject: Wyvern
facts.text: Wyverns are found far to the south on the little island, are susceptible to the Sleep spell, and pay out over 80-G.

evidence.quote: Wyverns can be found very far south, on the little island. They hit hard, but the Sleep spell works pretty well on them. They pay out over 80-G.

facts.subject: Green Dragon
facts.text: Inside the Swamp Cave, the Green Dragon is located through a small opening reached by going east and weaving south without returning to the western aisle.

evidence.quote: Head back to the Swamp Cave. Once in, use your Radiant spell (finally) and light up the area around you. Go east, and then weave your way to the south (without returning to the long aisle to the west) until you come to a small opening much like a doorway. Heal yourself, and enter. It's... A GREEN DRAGON!

facts.subject: Green Dragon
facts.text: The Green Dragon has about 60 Hit Points, strikes for 20 to 30 damage, and should immediately be put to sleep.

evidence.quote: Immediately put him to sleep; if it doesn't work, back out, heal, and return. The Dragon has about 60 Hit Points, and every hit you make will count for a little under 10. You have 62 Hit Points, and the Dragon hits for 20 to 30.

facts.subject: Princess Gwaelin
facts.text: After defeating the Green Dragon in Swamp Cave, walk south, open the door, and agree to take Princess Gwaelin to Tantegel.

evidence.quote: After defeating the Dragon, walk around to the south and open the door. Speak to the lovely Princess, who will ask you to take her to Tanegel. Say yes (if you say no, she will say 'But you must' and ask again).

facts.subject: Princess Gwaelin
facts.text: Returning Princess Gwaelin to the King at Tantegel Castle grants Gwaelin's Love, which reveals your coordinates in Alefgard and remaining Experience Points to the next level.

evidence.quote: Take her to the castle, and bring her to the King. He will be grateful, and Gwaelin will give you her love. You can use her love to figure out where you are in Alefgard, and how many Experience Points until you get your next Level

facts.subject: Garinham
facts.text: Chests on the east side of Garinham contain a torch, an herb, and 15-G.

evidence.quote: Once in Garinham, go to the east side of town and go through the door....The chests contain a torch, an herb, and 15-G.

facts.subject: Grave of Garin
facts.text: To enter the Grave of Garin, push against the northern darkness wall above the room containing two guards in east Garinham.

evidence.quote: Push on it above the room with the two guards in it. Follow the path to the old man, whom will tell you not to go in for the Silver Harp is inside. Don't listen to him; that guy north of Kol needs it, remember? Well, head on in.

facts.subject: Grave of Garin Level 1
facts.text: On level 1 of the Grave of Garin, three chests along the northern wall contain 26-G and an Herb.

evidence.quote: Follow the wall to the west, and you will soon find three chests, containing 26-G and an Herb.

facts.subject: Grave of Garin Level 3
facts.text: The Silver Harp is found on Level 3 of the Grave of Garin by bypassing dead-end staircases and taking the southern wall stairs down.

evidence.quote: This is a four level dungeon; the prize we are searching for is on level 3....Instead, follow the outside wall to the south, passing the first stairway you come to. Go down the next one. Follow the hallway north, go east at the split, and go down the stairs. Go around the wall in the middle of the room to the stairs on the other side, and go back up. Here you will find the Silver Harp.

facts.subject: Grave of Garin
facts.text: The Grave of Garin also contains the Cursed Belt.

evidence.quote: If you want to explore around a little more you can, but the only other item here is the Cursed Belt, which you really have no need for.

facts.subject: Old Man North of Kol
facts.text: Giving the Silver Harp to the man north of Kol rewards you with the Staff of Rain, after which he disappears.

evidence.quote: Pick up a free healing, and then go to the man north of Kol to collect the Staff of Rain (ooh, another piece of the Rainbow puzzle!). Don't worry; after you talk to him, he's supposed to disappear.

facts.subject: Magic Armor
facts.text: Equipping the Magic Armor restores 1 Hit Point for every four steps taken.

evidence.quote: The thing that is so special about the Magic Armor is that for every four steps you take, you gain 1 Hit Point!

facts.subject: Return
facts.text: The Return spell is learned at Level 13 and warps you back to Tantegel Castle for 8 Magic Points.

evidence.quote: Once you get the grand total of a little under 8000-G, you should also either have or almost have reached Level 13. With this level comes one of the most useful spells: Return. This spell will take you back to Tantegel Castle - no matter where you are, as long as you have the necessary 8 Magic Points.

facts.subject: Brecconary
facts.text: Fairy Water can be purchased in Brecconary to help keep enemies away.

evidence.quote: You may wish to buy a bottle of Fairy Water in Brecconary for this trip. Fairy Water works like bug spray: it helps to keep enemies away, though it doesn't always work too well.

facts.subject: Cantlin
facts.text: To reach Cantlin, head south past the gold-building area across the bridge, cross the desert south to a bridge east, cross it, go north-east, pass the first bridge, cross the next bridge with swamp on the other side, and head south.

evidence.quote: Continue beyond the area I told you to build up gold, across the bridge. Go south across the desert, and keep going south until you come to yet another bridge leading east. Go across, and go north-east. Pass by the first bridge, and cross the next (the one with a little swamp on the other side). Then go south; you will soon find a town surrounded by a wall.

facts.subject: Golem
facts.text: The Golem guards the opening of Cantlin and can be put to sleep during battle by playing the Fairy's Flute.

evidence.quote: In the opening will be the Golem. If you remember correctly, you should use the Fairy's Flute on him to put him to sleep. Fight him; if he awakes, then put him to sleep again. The reward really sucks, but you will gain access to Cantlin.

facts.subject: Erdrick's Token
facts.text: Erdrick's Token is hidden 70 spaces south and 40 spaces east of Tantegel Castle, locatable using Gwaelin's Love.

evidence.quote: A man behind a door and a barrier says to search 70 to the south and 40 to the east of Tantegel. Eventually, you will use Gwaelin's Love to find what's here (Erdrick's Token, to prove you are in the line of Erdrick).

facts.subject: Flame Sword
facts.text: Behind a locked door staffed by two people at desks in Cantlin, the Flame Sword is sold for 9800-G.

evidence.quote: The only door you need to open (though only if you have 9800-G) is the one with two people behind desks. You will buy the Flame Sword here.

facts.subject: Large Shield
facts.text: The Large Shield can be bought in Cantlin for 800-G.

evidence.quote: While you're in the city, you should also buy the Large Shield(800-G).

facts.subject: Silver Shield
facts.text: The Silver Shield can be purchased in Cantlin at the shop where the Flame Sword is sold, and trades in the Large Shield for 400-G.

evidence.quote: After finally getting the needed Gold, head back to Cantlin (running and healing, of course) and enter the place that you bought the Flame Sword. This should use up the last of your Keys. Buy the Silver Shield, and you will recieve 400-G for the Large Shield trade-in.

facts.subject: Repel
facts.text: Reaching Level 15 teaches the hero the Repel spell, which works like Fairy Water.

evidence.quote: Level 15 will be even better than 16, and you get a spell: Repel. This works like Fairy Water.

facts.subject: Axe Knight
facts.text: An Axe Knight guards the tree behind the shop in Hauksness where Erdrick's Armor is buried.

evidence.quote: Walk across the two swamp spaces, heal yourself fully no matter how many magic points it takes, and walk to the tree. Here you will find... an Axe Knight!

facts.subject: Erdrick's Armor
facts.text: Searching the area by the tree behind the shop in Hauksness after defeating the Axe Knight yields Erdrick's Armor.

evidence.quote: Search the area, and you will find the much sought-after Erdrick's Armor.

facts.subject: Erdrick's Armor
facts.text: Erdrick's Armor provides higher defense power, heals four times faster while walking, and grants invulnerability to swamps and barriers.

evidence.quote: This is better than the Magic Armor in three ways: It has a higher defense power; It heals you four times as fast while you're walking; and It makes you invulnerable to swamps and barriers!

facts.subject: Erdrick's Token
facts.text: Searching the large swamp south of Cantlin at the coordinates 70 south and 40 east of Tantegel yields Erdrick's Token.

evidence.quote: You will notice that we are pretty close to 70 south and 40 east of Tantegel (you heard those numbers in Cantlin, remember?). Use Gwaelin's Love to get to that certain spot, and search. Ta-da! Erdrick's Token.

facts.subject: Rainbow Drop
facts.text: The man in the cave south of Rimuldar exchanges the Staff of Rain and the Stones of Sunlight for the Rainbow Drop.

evidence.quote: Go past the town and go south to that cave with the rude guy in it. He will take the Staff of Rain and the Stones of Suntlight and give you the Rainbow Drop, the last piece of the Rainbow Puzzle.

facts.subject: Rainbow Bridge
facts.text: Using the Rainbow Drop on the peninsula west of Rimuldar creates the bridge leading across to Charlock Castle.

evidence.quote: Now, go north, past Rimuldar, and then west. You will find a little peninsula that looks like the perfect place for a bridge. Guess what? It is! Use the Rainbow Drop, and a bridge will miraculously appear before you. Go across, and follow the path to Charlock.

facts.subject: Secret Passage
facts.text: Searching behind the empty throne in Charlock Castle reveals a secret staircase leading down.

evidence.quote: Soon, you will be at the empty throne. Go behind it, and search the area. You will find a Secret Passage. Go down, and use Radiant.

facts.subject: Erdrick's Sword
facts.text: Taking the northwest path down the stairs, heading north and east, taking the stairs up twice, and following the path down leads to the chest containing Erdrick's Sword.

evidence.quote: Take the north-west road, and go down the stairs. In this new room, go north, then east. Pass that stairway leading down, and go south (to the west of the wall). Go up the stairway. Follow the path and go up the stairs at the end. Go up the next stairs. Follow the path, and go down the stairway. Finally, the chest! Open it up, and breathe a sigh of relief; it is in fact Erdrick's Sword.

facts.subject: Starwyvern
facts.text: Starwyverns should be countered with Sleep or Stopspell to prevent them from casting Healmore to restore up to 100 Hit Points.

evidence.quote: On Starwyverns, you should either use Sleep or Stopspell, because they love to draw the fight out by casting Healmore (heals up to 100 Hit Points!).

facts.subject: Healmore
facts.text: Reaching Level 17 unlocks the Healmore spell, which can restore up to 100 Hit Points.

evidence.quote: Level 17 really sucks, escept for the Healmore spell. This can heal up to 100 Hit Points, conveniently enough your maximum right now.

facts.subject: Hurtmore
facts.text: Reaching Level 19 unlocks the hero's final spell, Hurtmore.

evidence.quote: Finally, Level 19. Another big boost to your maximum Hit Points, and your last spell: Hurtmore.

facts.subject: Dragonlord
facts.text: If you agree to join the Dragonlord in his conquest when he asks, he kills you.

evidence.quote: He will ask you join him in his conquest of the world. Yeah, right. (If you said yes, he will babble about how you made the right choice, and then kill you.)

facts.subject: Dragonlord
facts.text: Magic does not work on the true Dragonlord form, so attack him directly and cast Healmore whenever Hit Points drop below 40 to defeat him and obtain the Ball of Light.

evidence.quote: Magic does not work on him, but you can still heal yourself. You should cast Healmore every time your Hit Points drop below 40; otherwise, attack him... When he does finally die, you will find the Ball of Light

facts.subject: Ball of Light
facts.text: Carrying the Ball of Light back through the Swamp Cave to Tantegel Castle completes the quest as King Lorik and the Princess celebrate the hero.

evidence.quote: Take the Ball of Light back to Tantegel Castle (yes, even though the game is essentially over, you still have to go through Swamp Cave just like anyone else). Once in the good castle, you will notice a celebration in progress... The King will tell you that you truly are in the line of Erdrick... Then, the Princess comes out and says that she wants to come with you.

facts.subject: Charlock Castle B2 Enemies
facts.text: Level 2 of Charlock Castle features the Blue Dragon and Stoneman, which both yield around 60 Experience Points.

evidence.quote: You have to be careful down here, though, because there are Axe Knights down here, along with two new baddies: the Blue Dragon and the Stoneman. Both are quite tough, but can get you around 60 Expirience Points.

facts.subject: Magic Points
facts.text: When grinding in Charlock Castle, keep Magic Points at 14 or above to ensure sufficient MP to cast Outside and Return.

evidence.quote: Also, never let your MP drop below 14; that is just enough to cast Outside and Return, to get you back to Tantegel and refuel your magic.

facts.subject: Fighter's Ring
facts.text: The Fighter's Ring is located in the Rock Mountain Cave southwest of Tantegel.

evidence.quote: Go to the Rock Mountain Cave (southwest of Tantegel) and get the Fighter's Ring.

facts.subject: Goldman
facts.text: The Goldman can be fought in the hills south of Rimuldar and the forest northeast of Hauksness.

evidence.quote: Look in the hills south of Rimuldar and the forest northeast of Hauksness. Fight the...Goldman.

facts.subject: Erdrick's Armor
facts.text: Erdrick's Armor is located in Hauksness, guarded by an Axe Knight.

evidence.quote: Erdrick's Armor is in Hauksness (gaurded by an Axe...Knight)

facts.subject: Erdrick's Sword

facts.object: Four resetting runs from one save

You'll need to do 3 runs to the final boss, and then a 4th run where you just rescue the Princess and bring her to the King.
1. Go to the Dragon Lord. When he offers to have you join him, accept, and die.
2. Go to the Dragon Lord. Fight and kill him, then return to the King, having never rescued the Princess.
3. Rescue the Princess, and take her to the Dragon Lord. Fight and kill him, then return to the King.
4. Rescue the Princess and take her immediately to the King.

evidence.quote: Went in this smelly cave over 200 times before I decided to turn off hardcore and just use a save state. After about 7 save state loads I got it.

facts.subject: Death Necklace
facts.text: A commenter switched from the FCEUmm to the QuickNES core on hardcore and got the necklace within 10 trips.

evidence.quote: I swapped from using FCEUmm core in RetroArch to QuickNES and got the necklace within 10 trips this time around (on hardcore).

facts.subject: Death Necklace
facts.text: A commenter doubts that an emulator core will change the random outcome.

evidence.quote: I don't think an emulator core will fix the RNG.

facts.subject: Death Necklace
facts.text: A commenter found the achievement only unlocked after saving and restarting the game.

evidence.quote: achievement didnt unlock for me until after i had saved my game and restarted it.

facts.subject: Death Necklace
facts.text: A commenter says to enter and leave the cave repeatedly, which is also good for grinding.

evidence.quote: The key is to just enter and leave over and over again.

facts.subject: Death Necklace
facts.text: A commenter claims that entering the dark cave without a torch or Radiant spell will eventually yield the necklace, with a 100% chance.

evidence.quote: To raise your chances of finding it (apparently to 100%) just enter the dungeon and do not use a torch or the radiant spell, go through the mountain cave in the dark and you will eventually find the death necklace.

facts.subject: Death Necklace chest
facts.text: The necklace chest holds 100-130 gold, not the chest before it, since one guide was mislabelled.

evidence.quote: Make sure you are checking the chest that contains the 100-130gold and not the one before it, the first guide I checked first was mislabelled.

facts.subject: Death Necklace
facts.text: A commenter defeated the Dragonlord first, then went to the cave when no monsters were encountered.

evidence.quote: I made this easier by defeating the Dragonlord, then going to the cave when there are no monster encounters.

facts.subject: Death Necklace
facts.object: Loot Torch, loot gold/necklace chest, cast Outside, repeat
facts.text: A commenter looted the Torch and the gold/necklace chest, cast Outside, and repeated.

evidence.quote: Loot Torch, loot gold/necklace chest, cast Outside, repeat.

facts.subject: Death Necklace
facts.text: After defeating the Dark Lord, a commenter used Return and went straight to the Mountain Cave to grind for the necklace.

evidence.quote: After you defeat the Dark Lord, use the Return spell, but instead of going to the king, just head to the mountain cave.

facts.subject: Torch
facts.text: One chest in the Mountain Cave contains a torch that regenerates each time you re-enter the cave.

evidence.quote: there is a torch in one of the chests that regenerates every time you re-enter the cave.

facts.subject: magic points
facts.text: A commenter says magic cannot be replenished after the endgame, so torches can be used when MP runs out.

evidence.quote: AFAIK there is no way to replenish your magic at this point so you can use the torches if you run out of magic.

facts.subject: Death Necklace
facts.text: A commenter used a 3x frame skip throttle to speed up grinding while still navigating the cave.

evidence.quote: I set the frame skip throttle to 3x to speed things up while still being able to navigate the maze and menus.

facts.subject: Death Necklace
facts.text: A commenter waited until after defeating the Dragonlord to avoid enemy encounters.

evidence.quote: I waited until after defeating the Dragonlord so there would be no enemy encounters

facts.subject: Death Necklace
facts.text: A commenter took 26 tries to get the necklace.

evidence.quote: It took me 26 tries.

facts.subject: Death Necklace
facts.text: A commenter used 3x fast-forward to grind for the necklace.

evidence.quote: using 3x fast-forward.

facts.subject: Death Necklace chest
facts.text: A commenter says the necklace chest is the one with 100+ gold.

evidence.quote: thanks for the comment that it's the 100+ gold chest

facts.subject: Death Necklace
facts.text: A commenter got the necklace on the second try using QuickNES while going in the dark.

evidence.quote: tried using QuickNES while going in the dark and got it on the second try.

facts.subject: Death Necklace
facts.text: A commenter says QuickNES and going in without a torch or Radiant spell do not make it easier, and that luck with the 1/32 chance is required.

evidence.quote: QuickNES doesn't make this easier, nor does going through the cave without using a torch or the radiant spell. You just need to get lucky with the 1/32 chance.

facts.subject: Death Necklace
facts.text: A commenter gives the formula P = 1 - 0.96875^N for the chance of having seen the necklace after N attempts.

evidence.quote: P=1-(0.96875)^(attempts) = your percent as a decimal

facts.subject: Magic Armour (regen)
facts.text: Pick up the Magic Armour (regen) from Rimuldar first to save MP for the Radiant spell.

evidence.quote: Pick up the magic armour(regen) from rimuldar first so you can save on mana for radiant

facts.subject: Death Necklace
facts.object: 2nd floor, southwest of the floor by itself
facts.text: The necklace chest is on the 2nd floor of the Mountain Cave, southwest of the floor by itself.

evidence.quote: the chest with the necklace is on the 2nd floor of the mountain cave, off to the southwest of the floor by itself.

facts.subject: Death Necklace chest
facts.text: The necklace chest normally holds 100-120 gold.

evidence.quote: Normally that chest has 100-120 gold in it.

facts.subject: Mountain Cave map
facts.text: The Mike's RPG Center map of the Mountain Cave is incorrect.

evidence.quote: The map on Mike's RPG Center is, unfortunately, incorrect.

facts.subject: Death Necklace
facts.text: The necklace is in the chest left from the wall; the map has chests 4 and 5 mixed up.

evidence.quote: Be aware it is wrong the two chests 4 and 5 are mixed. So the Neclace is in the chest left from the wall.

facts.subject: chests
facts.text: In Dragon Quest chests respawn indefinitely, so re-entering the level restores them.

evidence.quote: Yes because in DQ1 chests respawn indefinetly. Just reenter the level.

facts.subject: Death Necklace
facts.text: A commenter says the necklace is never obtained if all 8 item slots are full.

evidence.quote: Make sure you don't have 8 items slots filled (all) or else you wont get the item ever.

facts.subject: Death Necklace
facts.text: A commenter cast Radiant and Outside to reset the chest for about 20 runs until running out of MP.

evidence.quote: I was setup to be able to make 20 runs at the chest until I ran out of MP from casting radiant and outside to reset the chests.

facts.subject: Death Necklace
facts.text: A commenter killed the final boss first to stop random encounters while grinding.

evidence.quote: Killed the final boss to stop random encounters to make the grind less of a hassle.

facts.subject: Death Necklace
facts.text: With turbo mode on and a short path, a commenter's 7 attempts took about 5 minutes.

evidence.quote: But with turbo mode on and the path being relatively short, my 7 attempts took me only 5 minutes.

facts.subject: Death Necklace
facts.text: Selling the item yields a measly 1,200 gold.

evidence.quote: So much effort for such a useless item that you just end up selling for a measly 1,200 gold.

facts.subject: Dragon Warrior
facts.text: Do not rescue Princess Gwaelin initially, as beating the final boss without rescuing her is required for missable achievements.

evidence.quote: The only thing you need to keep in mind is to not rescue the princess when you get the chance to, as you need to beat the final boss once without having rescued her.

facts.subject: Dragon Warrior
facts.text: Before fighting the final boss for the first time, save the game, defeat him, reboot after credits, and then rescue Princess Gwaelin for the remaining missable achievements.

evidence.quote: Once you are ready to approach the final boss for the first time, save the game (optionally make a copy with the in-game feature if you want to be extra safe) and defeat him. After the credits roll and you reboot the game, you can then rescue the princess and go through the process again for the other missable achievements.

facts.subject: Magic Key
facts.text: The Magic Key is found by searching chests inside the King's chamber at Tantegel Castle.

evidence.quote: In the king's chamber, search every chest and find the Magic Key.

facts.subject: Door
facts.text: Approaching the door south of the king and using the Door command unlocks the chamber door.

evidence.quote: Approach the door south of the king, press A and select the Door option to unlock the door.

facts.subject: Erdrick's Tablet
facts.text: Erdrick's Tablet is found in the only chest on the second floor of a cave northwest of Tantegel Castle.

evidence.quote: Erdrick's Tablet can be found in a cave north-west on Tantegel. This cave is devoid of monsters, but as with every cave, it is dark so a torch is recommended to make progress. Head down to the second floor and you will find Erdrick's Tablet in the only chest.

facts.subject: Magic Key
facts.text: Magic Keys can be purchased in Rimuldar.

evidence.quote: Head to Garinham once you have at least two Magic Keys (you can purchase them in Rimuldar), and one or two torches unless you have the Illuminate spell.

facts.subject: Garin's Grave
facts.text: In Garinham, open the north house and hug the north black wall to find a passage leading into Garin's Grave.

evidence.quote: Open the house north and go inside, then hug the north black wall until you find the spot that lets you through a passage into Garin's Grave.

facts.subject: Cursed Belt
facts.text: The Cursed Belt is located in Garin's Grave.

evidence.quote: This is a cave consisting of four floors, and the Silver Harp is, unsurprisingly, at the very end. This cave also has the Cursed Belt for another achievement.

facts.subject: Silver Harp Path
facts.text: To reach the Silver Harp in Garin's Grave, open the right door on B1F to reach the middle staircase, navigate to the bottom-left on B2F, head north on B3F to the singular staircase, and take the middle staircase on B4F.

evidence.quote: On B1F,  open the door on the right, then make your way to the middle of the screen where the only staircase is....On B2F, make your way to the bottom-left of the screen....On B3F, go north from where you currently are, which will eventually make you end up at the singular staircase....On B4F, take the other singular staircase in the middle, then you will arrive at the Silver Harp.

facts.subject: Stones of Sunlight
facts.text: At Tantegel Castle, open the door in the top-right, go outside, walk down alongside the wall, move one space right, and walk down along the water to reach a staircase leading to the Stones of Sunlight.

evidence.quote: Once you have the key, head back to Tantegel Castle and go to the top-right, where you will be blocked by a door. Open this door, then go outside when you are given the option to. Walk downwards alongside the castle wall, then go one space to the right and go downwards along the water to reach a staircase. Here you will find the Stones of Sunlight.

facts.subject: Staff of Rain
facts.text: Giving the Silver Harp to the old man in the shrine west and up from Kol awards the Staff of Rain.

evidence.quote: The Silver Harp is required to get the Staff of Rain. Once you have this, head to Kol and then go west and up until you reach a shrine with an old man inside. Give him the Silver Harp, and the Staff of Rain is yours.

facts.subject: Erdrick's Token
facts.text: Erdrick's Token is hidden in the middle of the right side of the swamp located south of Cantlin.

evidence.quote: If you have the Princess' Pledge, you can call to her to find the location, which is "70 steps south, and 40 steps east" on Tantegel. You will most likely not have this if you are going for all the endings, so instead, go to the swamp south of Cantlin (you need to walk around from west). On the right side of this swamp, search for Erdrick's Token pretty much straight in the middle. Walk around here a bit and you will eventually find it.

facts.subject: Rainbow Drop
facts.object: Stones of Sunlight, Staff of Rain, Erdrick's Token
facts.text: Giving the Stones of Sunlight, Staff of Rain, and Erdrick's Token to the shrine south of Rimuldar yields the Rainbow Drop.

evidence.quote: Once you have the Stones of Sunlight, the Staff of Rain, and Erdrick's Token, head south of Rimuldar towards Erdrick's Shrine. Give him the items in exchange for the Rainbow Drop.

facts.subject: Rainbow Bridge
facts.text: Using the Rainbow Drop at the desert northwest of Rimuldar where the other side is separated by one tile of water builds the Rainbow Bridge.

evidence.quote: With the Rainbow Drop in hand, head to the desert north-west of Rimuldar. Get to the point where the other side is separated by only one tile of water, then use the Rainbow Drop to build the Rainbow Bridge.

facts.subject: Secret Stairs
facts.text: Searching behind the throne in Charlock Castle reveals secret stairs needed to proceed to the Dragonlord.

evidence.quote: Go to the throne room in Charlock Castle, then stand behind the throne and search to discover the secret stairs, necessary to proceed to the Dragonlord.

facts.subject: Dragonlord
facts.text: Accepting the Dragonlord's offer to rule together triggers the bad ending.

evidence.quote: When you finally find the Dragonlord at the bottom of Charlock Castle, he will offer you to rule with him. Accept his offer and you will receive the bad ending.

facts.subject: Dragonlord
facts.text: A minimum level of 20 is recommended to defeat the Dragonlord.

evidence.quote: The Dragonlord is the final- and toughest boss of the game, so being at the very least level 20 is recommended.

facts.subject: Dragonlord
facts.text: The Dragonlord has two phases, the first being a mage with low defense and HP, followed by a stronger second phase.

evidence.quote: The Dragonlord has two phases, with the first one being a mage with low defense and HP so just get rid of him as quickly as possible. The second phase is stronger but still not really that bad depending on your level.

facts.subject: Princess Gwaelin
facts.text: Thou Art a Jerk to Women is earned by returning to the castle after defeating the Dragonlord without saving Princess Gwaelin.

evidence.quote: Thou Art a Jerk to Women (25) [achievement 13419]...Beat the Dragonlord and return to the castle without saving Gwaelin...As the description mentions, return to the castle without saving the princess.

facts.subject: Princess Gwaelin
facts.text: Rescuing Princess Gwaelin requires a Magic Key, a torch or Illuminate magic, and defeating a Green Dragon in the cave south of Kol.

evidence.quote: To rescue the Princess, you will need a Magic Key, a torch or Illuminate magic, and a level of around 15 is also recommended as you need to defeat a Green Dragon (but given that you will likely do this with the endings, you will be fine). Once you have all the requirements, go south of Kol into the cave connecting to the continent with Rimuldar. On the right side in this cave you will run into the dragon that appears as a random encounter, so defeat it and then open the door to find the Princess.

facts.subject: Princess Gwaelin
facts.text: Bringing Princess Gwaelin to Charlock Castle and speaking with the Dragonlord unlocks the Thine Princess By Thine Side achievement.

evidence.quote: Once you have rescued the Princess in the achievement above, bring her with you to Charlock Castle and head towards the Dragonlord. The achievement will trigger once you talk to him, and there will be no additional benefits- or penalties so no need to worry about that.
you can literally bring the princess to the Dragonlord and then join his ranks.

facts.subject: Princess Gwaelin
facts.text: After defeating the Dragonlord, return to Tantegel Castle with Princess Gwaelin in tow and speak to the King to see the credits.

evidence.quote: Once you have defeated the Dragonlord, head back to Tantegel Castle, talk with the king and watch the credits!

facts.subject: Level Grinding
facts.text: For Levels 2 and 3, defeat Slimes and Drakees outside Tantegel up to around level 5 while buying gear in Tantegel Town.

evidence.quote: Level 2 and 3: just run outside Tantegel and defeat Slimes and Drakees. Recommended is to keep this up to around level 5 while stocking up on gear/armor Tantegel Town.

facts.subject: Level Grinding
facts.text: To reach Level 9, purchase the best available armor in Garinham and grind around the area or in the cave to the south.

evidence.quote: Level 9: Make your way north-west of Tantegel to Garinham. Buy the best armour you can, then grind around here for a bit or to the south where a cave is, where you can get an item for another achievement. May as well kill two birds with one stone to make the grind not painful. This cave is recommended to do until level 9. If you have money to burn (3,000 gold to be exact), you can also go to the far east of Garinham to Kol, which has better armour.

facts.subject: Goldman
facts.text: Goldmans south of Rimuldar drop more gold than any other enemy in the game.

evidence.quote: To the south of Rimuldar are not only good enemies like the Wyvern, but also the Goldman who drops more gold than any other enemy.

facts.subject: Level Grinding
facts.text: Garin's Grave is recommended as a grinding spot around Level 15 while retrieving the Silver Harp and Cursed Belt.

evidence.quote: Level 15: You can either decide to stay at the Goldmans for a bit longer, or instead do some more mandatory quests, like getting the Silver Harp and Cursed Belt. The Grave of Garin also is a pretty good grinding spot for around your level, so I would personally recommend it.

facts.subject: Cantlin Equipment
facts.text: In Cantlin, the sword costs 9,800 gold and the shield costs 14,800 gold.

evidence.quote: If you want, you can try to push through to Cantlin, the fortress city, and see if you have enough money to upgrade you armour; 9,800 gold is needed for the sword, and 14,800 for the shield.

facts.subject: Erdrick's Armor
facts.text: Erdrick's Armor can be found inside the ruined town of Hauksness.

evidence.quote: Hauksness is also where you can get Erdrick's Armour, so getting this as soon as possible is recommended.

facts.subject: Erdrick's Sword
facts.text: Erdrick's Sword is located inside Charlock Castle.

evidence.quote: First of all, it is highly recommended to have done everything you can at this point, including getting all of Erdrick's gear (the sword is in Charlock Castle) and possibly also the Death Necklace as you will be going down the dungeon several times for it anyway.

facts.subject: Metal Slime
facts.text: Metal Slimes appear as rare encounters to the southwest of Hauksness and can be one-shot once at Level 24.

evidence.quote: Alternative 1: Once you are Level 24, you can one-shot Metal Slimes to the south-west of Hauksness. I generally don't recommend this as they are rare encounters and don't offer that much more exp, but if you are tired of the same environment you can at least mix it up.

facts.subject: Fighter's Ring
facts.text: The Fighter's Ring is located on the lowest floor of the Mountain Cave south of Garinham, with a recommended level of at least 7.

evidence.quote: The Fighter's Ring is located on the lowest floor in the Mountain Cave south of Garinham. A level of 7 is recommended at the very least.

facts.subject: Fighter's Ring
facts.text: To reach the Fighter's Ring, on B1F go right instead of taking the northwest stairs and follow the first path down to the staircase, then on B2F go up and follow the path left to two chests.

evidence.quote:
To get as quick as possible to this chest, you need to:

- B1F: Go up and to the north-west to find a staircase. Don't go down here, and instead go to the right, then the first path down and follow the path to the staircase.
- B2F: Go up as soon as you can, then continue the path to the left and you will find two chests at the end, with one containing the Fighter's Ring.

facts.subject: Death Necklace
facts.text: The Death Necklace appears randomly in a chest on the lowest floor of the Mountain Cave south of Garinham, requiring multiple trips in and out of the dungeon until found.

evidence.quote: The Death Necklace is also located on the lowest floor in the Mountain Cave south of Garinham, but there is a catch: this one appears randomly in a chest. You will have to go down to the chest and then out of the dungeon again multiple times to get this item.

facts.subject: Death Necklace
facts.text: On B2F of the Mountain Cave, heading to the far southwest and up leads to a solitary chest containing either ~100 gold or the Death Necklace.

evidence.quote: - B2F: Go down as soon as you can and make your way to the very south-west of the map, then up until you see a singular chest. This is the one that will either have ~100 gold, or the necklace.

facts.subject: Fairy Flute
facts.text: The Fairy Flute is found in Kol by standing south of the open air bath, walking four squares south, and searching.

evidence.quote: What you need to do is go to Kol and walk up to the open air bath. Stand to the south of it, walk four squares south, and search. You will there find the Fairy Flute.

facts.subject: NPC
facts.text: An NPC in Rimuldar gives the location of the Fairy Flute, though speaking to him is not required to find it.

evidence.quote: An NPC in Rimuldar will tell you about the location, but you don't need to talk to him to find this item.

facts.subject: Cursed Belt
facts.text: The Cursed Belt is located on the bottom floor of Garin's Grave, with a recommended level of at least 13, two Magic Keys, and a torch or Illuminate spell.

evidence.quote: The Cursed Belt is in Garin's Grave, on the bottom floor, which is the same dungeon as where you get the Silver Harp so tackling these both at once is recommended. A level of 13 is recommended at the very least. You will also need two Magic Keys and a torch or two or the Illuminate spell.

facts.subject: Cursed Belt
facts.text: To reach the Cursed Belt, open the right door on B1F to reach the central stairs, take either the northwest or southeast stairs on B2F, and open the chest in the northwest of B3F.

evidence.quote: - B1F:  Open the door on the right, then make your way to the middle of the screen where the only staircase is....- B2F: Take either the staircase located in the north-west, or in the south-east....- B3F: Make your way to the north-west of this map, where you will find a chest with the Cursed Belt.

facts.subject: Silver Shield
facts.text: The Silver Shield must be bought for 14,800 gold in Cantlin.

evidence.quote: Although this achievement says to find the Silver Shield, what you need to do is buy it for 14,800 gold in Cantlin.

facts.subject: Axe Knight
facts.text: In Hauksness, stepping on the square with trees to the right of two swamp tiles triggers an encounter with the Axe Knight guarding Erdrick's Armor.

evidence.quote: In this destroyed city, you want to get to the square with trees that is to the right of two swamp tiles, on the right side of the city. You know you will be at the correct square when you are attacked by an Axe Knight defending it.

facts.subject: Erdrick's Armor
facts.text: A level of around 17 is recommended against the Axe Knight, after which searching the square yields Erdrick's Armour.

evidence.quote: This is a fairly strong enemy, so be prepared and have a level of around 17 when you attempt this. Once the Axe Knight is dead, search the square and you will find Erdrick's Armour.

facts.subject: Erdrick's Sword
facts.text: Erdrick's Sword is located in Charlock Castle, requiring the Rainbow Bridge to be built and a recommended level of around 18 or higher.

evidence.quote: Erdrick's Sword is located in Charlock Castle, the final dungeon. Before you go here, you need to have finished building the Rainbow Bridge, and be at a level of around 18 or higher.

facts.subject: Erdrick's Sword
facts.text: To reach Erdrick's Sword, take the stairs behind the throne on 0F, follow the single paths on B1F and B2F, turn left and up on B3F, and go to the top right of B4F to descend the stairs left of the staircase.

evidence.quote: - 0F: Find the staircase behind the throne and go down....- B1F/B2F: Follow these paths until the end, there is only one staircase to take for both....- B3F: Take the first path to the left, then up and keep following the path until the next shortcut....- B4F: Make your way to the top right of the map, then stand left of the staircase and go down....Once you have taken this staircase, just keep following the paths until you inevitably arrive at Erdrick's Sword.

facts.subject: Blue Slime
facts.text: The Blue Slime roams around Tantegel and is defeated to level up.

evidence.quote: This enemy roams around Tantegel and is pretty much required to level up. Just defeat one and the achievement is yours.

**Slime**
HP: 3
Gold: 1
EXP: 1
Special Attacks – None
Spell(s) – None
Area – Fields around Tantegel 
Base Type - Slime

facts.subject: Goldman
facts.text: The Goldman is found south of Rimuldar, near and slightly above the shrine, and provides good money.

evidence.quote: This enemy is located only south of Rimuldar, near the shrine and slightly above of it. Keep running around here until you find one... and stay here for a while because it's good money.

facts.subject: Wyvern
facts.text: The Wyvern appears south of Rimuldar in the same location as the Goldman, and also roams outside of Hauksness.

evidence.quote: You will encounter the Wyvern at the same location as the Goldman, south of Rimuldar. If by some miracle you don't come across it, it also roams outside of Hauksness.

facts.subject: Metal Slime
facts.text: The Metal Slime is located southwest of Hauksness, possesses high defense and tends to run away, but becomes a guaranteed one-shot kill at level 24.

evidence.quote: The Metal Slime is located south-west of Hauksness, and is a tough enemy to kill thanks to its high defense and tendency to run away. You can either just keep running around there and hope you end up lucky, or wait until level 24 where it will be a guaranteed one-shot.
